name: ANDREW V. CONCEPCION
headline: AI-Native Software Engineer | Kotlin | Jetpack Compose | Compose Multiplatform
summary: AI-native software engineer with deep platform knowledge and 10+ years of experience shipping production systems across crypto, fintech, streaming, telecom, transport, rewards, safety, and e-commerce. Strong in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, mobile architecture, performance tuning, release hardening, and third-party integrations. Known for agent-first execution, strong engineering judgment, and moving effectively across Android, iOS, backend, product, and design to ship reliable user-facing systems.

experience.title: AI-Native Software Engineer
bullets: Led the foundation and first end-to-end Android implementation of a multichain rewards platform, then built reward-backed crypto market predictions and moved their service layer into shared Rust through UniFFI.

Co-built Bitcoin replace-by-fee with fee-aware UTXO validation, speed-up/cancel flows, reusable transaction preparation and signing, opt-out controls, and dust protection; led an in-app single-chain-to-multichain wallet migration.

Modernized staking and liquidity-reward pool reads from legacy RPC to typed REST, shipped provider-aware swap routing and recurring-buy reminders, and hardened startup, native builds, CI, and Android releases.

experience.title: Senior Mobile Developer
bullets: Built a recommendations panel that appears during playback, coordinating its animations with player-control and button movement across phone and tablet layouts.
Independently delivered timeline scrubbing with a visual preview so viewers could see where playback would land before seeking.
Fixed long-standing player issues and improved reliability with stronger error tracking, security fixes, and a Simple XML-to-Jackson migration.

experience.title: Senior Android Developer
bullets: Built and launched OCBC Business mobile banking flows spanning onboarding, account dashboards, transfers, and digital account opening.
Integrated third-party SDKs, refactored selected modules to reduce coupling, and improved unit-test coverage for critical fintech flows.
Improved OpenPay checkout reliability, UI responsiveness, partner-integrated payment flows, and release hardening.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Led an offshore team of five senior Android engineers on MySTC, serving 10M+ installs across multilingual customer journeys.
Drove Clean Architecture and MVVM adoption with RxJava and RxKotlin, improving modular boundaries and release confidence.
Delivered performance, stability, and data synchronization improvements across account, ordering, and support flows.

experience.title: Team Lead
bullets: Led cross-functional delivery across Android, iOS, and backend for a ride-hailing platform that grew to 500K+ downloads.
Architected the mobile app with Uber RIB-inspired patterns to support modular growth and clearer ownership boundaries.
Improved booking reliability, payment-path handling, and backend API coordination for real-time transport flows.

experience.title: Senior Android Developer
bullets: Led Android development for a rewards app with 1M+ downloads across Southeast Asia.
Migrated large Java surfaces to Kotlin, reduced regressions in fragile areas, and shipped safer feature rollouts through A/B testing and guardrails.
Improved API and caching behavior while keeping monetization-critical lockscreen and notification surfaces stable.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web and Mobile Developer
bullets: Delivered end-to-end features for WebSafety across Android, iOS, web, and backend systems.
Worked through undocumented Android APIs, GPS and sync reliability, and security-sensitive feature requirements.
Helped ship a robust parental-controls platform with stronger operational and compliance posture.
